description: Explicit exemptions for the policy/secret scanner (scripts/policy-scan.mjs). Entries are precision-scoped: exact file paths + ruleIds + a recorded rationale. No blanket rules, no .gitignore-style silent skips. A real secret moved into a covered file is still caught by any rule NOT listed here. Rationales deliberately avoid embedding literal token shapes so the registry itself stays scanner-clean.

entries.rationale: Fixture apiKey with an sk-…-shaped value drives redaction assertions over the profiles data-plane (create/list/get never persist the key).
Loopback transport fixtures use opaque throwaway peer tokens to test auth plumbing; values are never real credentials.
Tray activation seam fixture feeds a throwaway secret-shaped token through makePlane to exercise the shared activation runner.
Fixture asserts the authorization response header is exactly a Bearer-style fixture token; proves the mock REST client composes headers.
CLI activation seam fixtures pass throwaway secret-shaped tokens through makeFakeEnv; process-env plumbing, never a real secret.
Profile show fixture uses a token shaped like sk-lmps-… (marker 'test' already excludes the assignment rule) to assert the key is never printed.
Capture-snapshot fixture: a secret-shaped token in the input readback plus the assertions that it does not survive capture and becomes the redaction tombstone.
Activation-transaction redaction fixture: a secret-shaped token that must never reach the audit record, asserted via not-contains plus the redaction tombstone.
Import/export round-trip fixture uses a short sk-…-shaped apiKey and a secret-valued credential to assert secrets survive the file round-trip shape but are never logged.

The policy scanner's own regression tests construct every content-rule shape under test (all fake, concatenated at runtime); the fixture sentinel marks this file. Rules listed individually — no * entry.
Verification script mints a random per-run token string used only as the stdio sidecar handshake argument (auth frame); ephemeral process scope, never persisted, displayed, or logged.
M6-003 real child-process fixtures assign opaque throwaway per-run session tokens to drive the stdio/HTTP auth handshake and lock/redaction assertions; values are never real credentials.
